svg.title: pipeline.run: process text and chunks in order
svg.desc: Text and chunks are separate state: transform changes text, chunk snapshots that text into chunks, and chunkTransform changes existing chunks. A later text transform does not rebuild them. Failure stops later steps; without chunk, chunks remains empty.
svg.metadata: flowchart TB A["run(text): supply the text"] B["clean: clean the text with options"] C["transform: transform current text"] D["chunk: build chunks from the current text"] E["chunkTransform: transform existing chunks"] F["Return successful { text, chunks }"] X["Return failure; skip subsequent steps"] A --> B B --> C C --> D D --> E E --> F B -->|"failure"| X C -->|"failure"| X D -->|"failure"| X E -->|"failure"| X classDef default fill:#edf3ff,stroke:#476aab,color:#172b4d,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef good fill:#e9f6ef,stroke:#28734e,color:#17452f,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef stop fill:#fff0f0,stroke:#af4040,color:#742b2b,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef pending fill:#fff6df,stroke:#a07827,color:#654b18,stroke-width:1.5px; class F good; class X stop;

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif

svg.text: pipeline.run: process text and chunks in order
